\caption{Uniform powder test battery. Seven test protocols are run in a fixed order with frozen parameters on every powder, so that the results are directly comparable across powders; the battery is a characterization sequence rather than an optimization workflow. Protocols A--F characterize the actuation primitives one at a time, and protocol G exercises the three-phase closed-loop controller built on them. Tilt is measured from horizontal (0$^\circ$ = auger tube horizontal, 90$^\circ$ = vertical). \emph{Trials} is the number of machine-readable trial records each protocol emits per run, which is the unit of replication in the analysis. Parameter values are the frozen defaults of the battery firmware (\texttt{hardware/test-module/firmware/powder\_battery.py}), which identifies the protocols by the same letters.}
\label{tbl:protocols}
